name: inertia
description: Visual Studio Code extension for Inertia.js

scripts.build: bun build --format cjs --outdir dist --external vscode src/extension.ts
scripts.dev: bun build --watch --format cjs --outdir dist --external vscode src/extension.ts

inertia.pagesFolder.description: Root folder of your applications' pages. The path is relative to the root of the workspace.
inertia.pagesFolder.deprecationMessage: Discontinued in favor of the inertia.pages setting.

inertia.pages.description: A glob pattern to match the Vue components that you use as pages in your Inertia application. The root folder of your components is inferred from the glob pattern.

prefix.description: The prefix used in component names (e.g., 'Shipping', 'Accounting')

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match components for this resolver (e.g., 'Modules/Shipping/Pages/**/*.tsx')

inertia.pageResolvers.description: Array of page resolvers, each with a prefix and corresponding glob pattern. This allows support for modular applications with multiple page directories.

inertia.pathShortcuts.description: Map of shortcuts to module names. E.g. {"AC": "Accounting"} maps AC:Reports/Balance to Modules/Accounting/Pages/Reports/Balance.

inertia.pathSeparators.markdownDescription:
The allowed path separators for component names.

**This setting only affects how the extension resolves the component paths and autocompletion, and you must ensure that you Inertia setup handles them as well.**

**When using autocompletion, component names will be shown with the first path separator.**

inertia.defaultExtension.description: The default file extension to use when generating hyperlinks to components that do not yet exist on the filesystem.
